services.value: Green Country Testing provides analytical testing for organics, metals, and general wet chemical analysis, including metals by ICP/ICP/MS and cold vapor, organics by GC/GC/MS, and microbiological analysis for Enterococci, Total and Fecal Coliform, and E. coli. It also offers sampling services such as wastewater composite and grab samples, pick-up/drop-off, composite sampler setup, and on-site measurements/analysis like pH, temperature, and Total Residual Chlorine.
